prompts.brief: We're a 6-person SaaS startup. Track companies, contacts and deals through stages: lead, demo booked, trial, negotiation, won, lost. Deal has amount and expected close date. Dashboard of open deals by stage.
prompts.expect: 3 modules + pipeline stages + Admin board/list view

prompts.brief: Same as a basic sales CRM, but every deal above €25,000 must be approved by the founder before it can be marked won.
prompts.expect: approval workflow, human-only decision, boundary tests at €24,999/€25,000

prompts.brief: Sales CRM for a company selling in EUR and USD. Weighted pipeline value by stage probability. Deals need a signed-contract file reference before won.
prompts.expect: multi-currency cents fields, computed weighted values, required-field policy on stage transition

prompts.brief: Import our existing customer list (CSV attached) into a new CRM with companies, contacts, deals; dedupe by email domain.
prompts.expect: import path through services (not raw SQL), dedupe policy explicit, audit of import actor

prompts.brief: Track annual contracts with renewal dates. 90 days before renewal, create a renewal opportunity assigned to the account owner.
prompts.expect: date-driven workflow, follow-up records, trace of runs

prompts.brief: Renewals above €50,000 moving to proposal require manager approval.
prompts.expect: the Milestone 0 slice reproduced by generation, not by hand

prompts.brief: Contracts with seat counts and per-seat pricing; upsell opportunities when usage > seats. Monthly summary of at-risk renewals (no activity in 30 days).
prompts.expect: derived at-risk policy explicit and tested

prompts.brief: Agency CRM: clients, projects, proposals. Proposal stages: draft, sent, accepted, rejected. When accepted, create a project.
prompts.expect: cross-module workflow with compensation if project creation fails

prompts.brief: Track retainers with monthly hours; flag clients over 90% usage.
prompts.expect: threshold policy, notification provider hook

prompts.brief: Proposals need two internal sign-offs (account lead + finance) if over €10k, one otherwise.
prompts.expect: multi-approver workflow, both identities human, audit shows both

prompts.brief: Realtor CRM: properties, buyers, viewings. Match buyers to properties by budget range and city.
prompts.expect: matching as deterministic query service, not AI guessing

prompts.brief: Offers on properties: multiple buyers can bid; owner must approve accepted offer; other offers auto-decline with notification.
prompts.expect: transactional multi-record workflow with compensation

prompts.brief: Recruiting pipeline: candidates, roles, applications through stages screen → interview → offer → hired/rejected.
prompts.expect: pipeline modules, stage transition workflow

prompts.brief: Offers above band maximum for the role require HR-director approval; store band per role.
prompts.expect: policy reads reference data; boundary tests

prompts.brief: We sell event sponsorships: sponsors, packages (gold/silver/bronze), deals per event edition.
prompts.expect: enum-typed package field via manifest, per-edition scoping

prompts.brief: Sponsorship inventory is limited per package per event; selling out a package blocks new deals at proposal stage with a clear error.
prompts.expect: inventory constraint in service layer, concurrency-safe

prompts.brief: Donor CRM: donors, campaigns, donations; thank-you task created for donations over €500.
prompts.expect: threshold workflow, task record

prompts.brief: Recurring donors: monthly pledges, lapsed-pledge detection (missed payment 15 days).
prompts.expect: date policy explicit and tested

prompts.brief: Partner CRM: partners with tiers silver/gold/platinum, territories, referred deals with revenue share by tier.
prompts.expect: the partner manifest from the framework examples extended with a workflow; revenue share as deterministic table

prompts.brief: Tier upgrades are automatic on referred-revenue thresholds but downgrades require human approval.
prompts.expect: asymmetric policy encoded exactly

prompts.brief: Onboarding CRM: accounts progress through onboarding checklist steps; stalled accounts (7 days no step) escalate to CS lead.
prompts.expect: checklist as module records, escalation workflow

prompts.brief: Health scoring from explicit rules (login frequency bands, open tickets, NPS); score changes are audited; red accounts create a save-play workflow with manager approval on discounts.
prompts.expect: scoring rules as data, not model calls; approval boundary tested
